about: The corpus register (chapter 28.12): every outside collection of models the tests run over, with its source, version, SHA-256, licence, and whether we may store it. geom_test::corpus holds the rules; `corpus digest` prints what a new entry needs.

corpora.what: Manifold's test models and samples
corpora.credit: Manifold, Emmett Lalish and contributors, Apache-2.0

corpora.what: 10,000 models from a 3D-printing site, many of them broken, each under its own licence
corpora.used_for: Mesh import, repair, booleans, fuzz seeds
corpora.decision: only models whose own licence 32.11's rule (i) admits, each recorded with its licence and credit; main records the list (32.53, 32.57)

corpora.what: EMBER's 1,000 boolean pairs: the list, stored; its meshes are Thingi10K's and wait with it
EMBER's 92 pairs whose two models' own licences rule (i) of 32.11 admits: their 171 Thingi10K models, file by file with each one's licence and credit, and EMBER's case list
corpora.used_for: Mesh booleans held to the rational reference, and their benchmark (Gate 4, G156)
corpora.version: Thingi10K's dataset at commit 2d5d3b2f3cd3711028ad75b12788c13b25559ec6 (its tag v1.5.0); Manifold at d056b8fb70de8c8e6d6bee2e639b71c20aa08d01
corpora.licence: Apache-2.0 AND LicenseRef-Thingi10K-CC-BY AND LicenseRef-Thingi10K-CC-Public-Domain-Dedication AND LicenseRef-Thingi10K-Public-Domain
corpora.credit: Thingi10K, Qingnan Zhou and Alec Jacobson (2016), each model credited to its author with its file; EMBER's case list, Manifold's benchmark harness, Apache-2.0
